clauses.title: Scope
clauses.text: 1. Scope —  Requirements for patterns, sizes, construction, dimensions, finish, flushing tests, inspection and marking for vitreous squatting pans.

clauses.title: Patterns and sizes
clauses.text: 2.1 Patterns and sizes a) Long 580 and 630 mm ( See Fig.1) b) Orissa 580 × 440 and 630 × 450 mm (See Fig.1) c) Rural 480 mm (See Fig 3) Note — For detailed dimension and tolerances refer to 6 of the  standard. SUMMARY OF IS : 2556 (PART 3)  1994 VITREOUS SANITARY  APLLIANCES (VITREOUS CHINA)  PART 3 SPECIFIC REQUIREMENTS OF SQUATTING PANS (Fourth Revision) Note —   Foot rest may be flushed or raised, clearance permissible between raised footrest and rim opening. FIG. 1  LONG  PATTERN  SQUATTING  PAN FIG. 2  ORISSA PATTERN SQUATTING PAN All dimensions in millimetres. FIG. 3  RURAL  PATTERN  SQUATTING  PAN

clauses.title: Each pan except the rural pattern shall have
clauses.text: 2.2 Each pan except the rural pattern shall have  an integral flushing rim of the suitable.

clauses.title: Pan of 630 mm shall be of box rim type
clauses.text: 2.3 Pan of 630 mm shall be of box rim type. Pan of sizes smaller than 630 mm may be either box rim or   open rim type. The flushing rim and inlet shall be of self draining type.

clauses.title: Trap with P or
clauses.text: 2.4 Trap with P or  S outlet (withor without inspection vent ) for long and orissa pattern. The trap shall conform to  IS  2556 ( Part 13) : 1973+.

clauses.title: Toilet Paper Test
clauses.text: 3.1 Toilet Paper Test — When repeated four times, the pan shall discharge full charge of paper at least thrice.

clauses.title: Smudge Test
clauses.text: 3.2 Smudge Test — Immediately after flushing there shall be no smudge left on the pan.

clauses.title: Water Holding Capacity Test
clauses.text: 3.3 Water Holding Capacity Test — Shall be capable of holding not less than 10 litres of water between the normal water level and highest possible water level of the pan installed. + Specific requirements of traps for squatting pans. Note 1 —  For method of tests, refer to 8 of the  standard. Note 2 — For general requirements refer to Part 1 General requirements of the standard. For  detailed information, refer to IS  2556 (Part 3) : 1994 Vitreous sanitary appliances  (vitreous china): Part 3 Specific requirements of squatting  pan (fourth revision).
